g.title: crate Shared pure UI values and backend-neutral text queries.
crate::animatable Component interpolation for scalar, tuple, and geometry values.
crate::asset What an image or a font file is read from.
crate::cell Share diagnostic latches, caches, generations and mailboxes.
crate::check Layout validation rules, limits and findings.
crate::color Adapter-neutral color values (text styles are in `text`).
crate::defaults Define the common fallback frame, window and click settings once.
crate::drag_velocity Estimate release velocity from recent pointer samples.
crate::embed Pure options and parent identities for embedded windows.
crate::env Host environment, capabilities and lifecycle events.
crate::gpu GPU adapter choice and textures shared with an external render engine.
crate::ids Shared node, region, request and text identities and identity maps.
crate::image_status Describe the observable loading state of an image asset.
crate::input Portable keyboard, modifier, button, file drag and IME values.
crate::layout Layout configuration, leaf measurement and overlay constraints.
crate::motion Animation timing, transitions, easing and spring stepping.
crate::paint Shared node paint, image payloads, effects and state-dependent styling.
crate::platform Native platform requests, dialog options and classified failures.
crate::presence Describe the observable lifetime of a displayed node.
crate::process Remember process-wide thread detachment for safe native module retention.
crate::render::color Color matrices (CSS filter functions as 4×5 matrices).
crate::render::effect Layers, filters, masks, box shadows and backdrops of a scene.
crate::render::paint What scene fills and strokes are painted with.
crate::render::scene Portable display lists, CPU frames and external GPU frames.
crate::render::semantics Semantics trees and updates for platform accessibility APIs.
crate::render::shaped Shaped text: glyph runs, lines, decoration and highlight rects.
crate::render::text Rich text and text styles a host hands Arvane to shape.
crate::scene Shared drawing primitives and authored draw records.
crate::scene::path Owned portable path command recordings.
crate::scene::primitives Pure fill, border and stroke primitives shared with renderers.
crate::scene::recording Authored draw records and their geometry and text payloads.
crate::scene::shape Paths, rounded rectangles and shapes in logical pixels.
crate::scroll Scroll snapping policy and the shared nearest-stop calculation.
crate::semantics Canonical node semantics, relation mapping and accessible value choices.
crate::semantics::finite Finite numeric semantics with equality-consistent bit hashing.
crate::semantics::node Store one canonical node semantics value and map its relation targets.
crate::semantics::validation Validate declared accessible text runs and selection geometry.
crate::semantics::values Accessible roles, actions, states and ARIA value choices.
crate::semantics_text Portable editable text runs, carets and selection snapshots.
crate::text Text primitives and declared or computed text properties.
crate::text::computed Resolve inherited typography without losing relative length semantics.
crate::text::primitives Text alignment, kerning, overflow, case, line height and metrics.
crate::text::properties Authored text content with declared and computed typography.
crate::text_shaping Backend-neutral text shaping and measurement queries.
crate::text_utf Convert clamped UTF-8 byte positions and platform UTF-16 code-unit offsets.
crate::view_transform Passive uniform content-to-view coordinate transforms.
